description: Returns a player's match-by-match rating history for one season: each match they played, their level before and after it, and the other players on court with their levels then. Call it when someone asks how a player's level changed, how they reached it, what one result did to it, or asks to see their matches. Prefer it to query_player_history when the question is about the level rather than the results, because it follows the level match by match.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

player.description: Player name as the member wrote it. Or the player's Desk page link or number.

season.description: Season year. Omit for the current season.

name: query_match_log
title: Desk level, match by match
